summary: Backend-only test of site link-repair + client city PATCH + cascading Admin Sales Report. Created a fresh corporate client, city and a site (without company_id/city_id), then PATCHed the site with {company_id, city_id} and verified GET persistence. Verified PATCH /api/master/corporate-clients/{id} accepts city_id and persists. Verified /api/admin/sales-report/filters returns clients/cities/sites (with company_id + city_id) and vendors (with site_ids) and includes DEMO seed rows. Verified all filtered totals for month=2026-06 exactly match main-agent expectations: grand=3975/14, Acme=2390/8, Bengaluru=2505/9, Acme+Mumbai=1170/3, Acme+Globex=3675/12; response contains client_summary/city_summary/site_summary/vendor_summary. Verified xlsx export contains 4 sheets (Orders, City Totals, Site Totals, Vendor Totals). Verified RBAC: a self-registered employee gets 403 on PATCH /api/sites/{id} with company_id and on both /api/admin/sales-report and /api/admin/sales-report/filters. All test-created rows (client cascade, site, city, rbac user) cleaned up. DEMO seed left intact.
